acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-finish and dogfood-seal commits use GIT_AUTHOR_* and GIT_COMMITTER_* when set
A test runs the commit step with exported identity variables and a different global identity and asserts the commit author and committer
body: Observed by context-1021d lane on 2026-10-21 (PR #1439). With GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL and GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL exported to the charter identity, the sealed commit carried the global user.email instead, so the lane redid dogfood in a fresh clone (third run against a two-run budget, roughly 10+ minutes lost). Suspected cause: a git invocation in the finish/seal path builds a clean environment that drops GIT_* identity variables.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by e66a5bf30: internal/dogfoodflow/identity_env_test.go runs the dogfood commit step with exported GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* and a different global identity and asserts author and committer. Verified by lane dftool-1021m.

title: make dogfood-finish commits the CEM with the global git identity instead of the exported GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER identity
